$schemaNote: Shaped to map into the `SupplierCapability` type (see lib/types.ts on origin/claude/issue-2-implementation-3g9kzq, referenced for field-naming only). EVERY record in this file has layer='declared' - there are no exceptions, per AGENTS.md rule 5 and the issue's guardrails. No observed-layer records exist because there is no transaction history. toleranceMm is populated with the tightest end of any stated range, converted to mm, alongside the raw claim text - treat it as illustrative, not a guaranteed achievable tolerance. quantityRange/sizeEnvelopeMm use null with an explanatory note where the supplier does not publish a number. SCHEMA FIX (AUDIT-001, 2026-09-19): 'processId'/'materialIds' have been renamed to 'processRaw'/'materialsRaw' because their values were free-text research labels, not the repo's canonical IDs (e.g. 'cnc_milling_turning' vs 'proc-cnc-milling'/'proc-cnc-turning'). New 'canonicalProcessIds'/'canonicalMaterialIds' arrays hold only confidently-matched canonical IDs (checked against lib/mock/data.ts's process/material lists) and are empty where no confident match exists -- most materials in this raw-research set have no canonical ID yet because the app's seed material list (3 materials) is far narrower than what real suppliers publish. Every record now also carries the Traceable-required status/createdAt/updatedAt/owner fields, and every evidence[] entry has an id. This file is still NOT directly importable as a typed SupplierCapability[] without a transformation step -- sizeEnvelopeMm/quantityRange remain nullable here (unlike the app type, where they're required) precisely because most of this data is genuinely unknown; see validate-seed-data.mjs for a repeatable check of what resolves vs. what's still raw-only.
